achievements.name: Take A Breather
achievements.description: During the Fugitives - Breather chapter, have both players sit together on the rock to enjoy the view.

achievements.name: In Sync
achievements.description: At the Farmstead, have both players play music together - Vincent on piano, Leo on banjo - hitting 20 notes in a row without a mistake.

achievements.name: Timeless Treasure
achievements.description: At the Farmstead, have both players push the grandfather clock at the same time to reveal a secret door, then open the treasure chest inside.

achievements.name: Break From Reality
achievements.description: You played a videogame with a friend.

achievements.name: Mayday!
achievements.description: You almost took to the skies.

achievements.name: Managed Anger
achievements.description: During the Preparation - Violent Questioning chapter, choose to push back the interrogated man's chair instead of escalating further.

achievements.name: Live the Dream
achievements.description: During the Preparation - A New Life chapter, have both players sit on the hospital waiting-room couch and watch the TV until one of them dozes off into a moon-landing dream, then run toward the lander.

achievements.name: Take It For A Spin
achievements.description: At the Farmstead, climb the windmill and interact with it to spin it up.

achievements.name: You Started It
achievements.description: During the Preparation - Reunion chapter, have both players sit on the trailer-park seesaw to trigger an argument over who sat first.

achievements.name: The Dip
achievements.description: At the start of the game in the prison yard, have Leo use the pull-up bars to beat the current inmate record.

achievements.name: Home Run
achievements.description: You are clearly good with a bat.
